title: Truss Bridge Builder
tagline: Bridge Works: a real direct-stiffness solver — the cheapest surviving bridge wins
hub_blurb: Build a truss, watch the real solver expose tension, buckling, and collapse, then compete for the cheapest bridge that survives.
card_blurb: Truss bridge builder on a real direct-stiffness solver: live tension and compression, Euler buckling, progressive collapse. Cheapest bridge that survives wins.
description: **Truss Bridge Builder** — a truss design lab for physics class. Real direct-stiffness truss solver, live tension/compression colouring, Euler buckling, progressive collapse, five levels with golf-style par budgets plus a sandbox. The printable teacher guide is also the in-app presenter notes, from one source.
